goal: Make agent crashes retry inside the same lifecycle by introducing a non-terminal Status.INTERNAL_ERROR that mirrors FAILED_VALIDATION's retry behavior under the existing max_retries budget.

references: src/flywheel/lifecycle.py -- mirror the FAILED_VALIDATION shape: _VALID_EDGES entries, _REQUIRES_ERROR membership, is_retry_eligible branch, retry-edge clearing logic
src/flywheel/harness.py:454 -- existing FAILED_VALIDATION retry branch is the pattern; reuse harness.retry_scheduled (do not add a new event kind)
src/flywheel/harness.py:585-601 -- current crash path that finalizes attempt as Outcome.INTERNAL_ERROR and transitions lifecycle to FAILED; route through the new status instead
constraints: Add Status.INTERNAL_ERROR = 'internal_error' to flywheel.lifecycle.Status with edges RUNNING -> INTERNAL_ERROR, INTERNAL_ERROR -> READY, INTERNAL_ERROR -> FAILED; include INTERNAL_ERROR in _REQUIRES_ERROR.

Extend Lifecycle.is_retry_eligible so status in (FAILED_VALIDATION, INTERNAL_ERROR) and retries < max_retries returns True; extend the retry-edge detection in transition_to so both statuses going to READY increment retries and clear the error.

Route the harness crash path (currently transitions to Status.FAILED with Outcome.INTERNAL_ERROR) through the new Status.INTERNAL_ERROR instead; the attempt outcome stays Outcome.INTERNAL_ERROR and the harness.crash event stays unchanged.

Extend the retry branch in the harness run loop so Status.INTERNAL_ERROR follows the same path as Status.FAILED_VALIDATION: emit harness.retry_scheduled when eligible, transition to READY; transition to FAILED with the inherited error when exhausted.
Update docs/task-lifecycle.md to document the new status, the new edges, and the broadened retry rule; keep wording terse and consistent with existing prose.

Update tests/test_harness.py crash-path test (around line 540-570) to reflect that a single crash now lands in INTERNAL_ERROR (retry-eligible) rather than FAILED; add coverage for crash-retries-exhausted ending in FAILED with the error preserved.

Add Lifecycle-level tests covering: is_retry_eligible True/False for INTERNAL_ERROR; INTERNAL_ERROR -> READY clears error and increments retries; INTERNAL_ERROR -> FAILED requires an error; illegal transitions out of INTERNAL_ERROR raise LifecycleTransitionError.
No new event kinds, no new modules, no new dependencies; flywheel.lifecycle remains pure (no json/pathlib/io imports).
Run `mcp__ide__getDiagnostics` on every .py file you touch and fix all Pylance errors before reporting verify -- treat them as build failures.
Commit the change with a Conventional Commits message (e.g. 'feat:') before reporting verify.
non_goals: Do not capture session ids, git snapshots, or resume preambles -- those are parked future work in the spec.
Do not reset the working tree between attempts.
Do not introduce a bounded outer-worker retry budget; the inner retry budget is the entire scope.
Do not change flywheel.task or weaken module-purity tests.
edge_cases: Crash on a retry attempt: the second crash must again land in INTERNAL_ERROR and consume another retry slot before finalizing as FAILED on exhaustion.
FAILED_VALIDATION path must remain byte-for-byte equivalent for existing callers: retry counts, event emission, and terminal transitions.
Status.FAILED stays terminal; only INTERNAL_ERROR is the new non-terminal addition.
consecutive_failed_runs() already treats Outcome.INTERNAL_ERROR as a failed outcome; do not change that helper.

graders.run: uv run python -c "from flywheel.lifecycle import Status; assert Status.INTERNAL_ERROR.value == 'internal_error'"
graders.name: status-enum

graders.run: uv run python -c "from flywheel.lifecycle import Lifecycle, Status; lc = Lifecycle(task_id='t', status=Status.INTERNAL_ERROR, retries=0); assert lc.is_retry_eligible(max_retries=1) is True; lc2 = Lifecycle(task_id='t', status=Status.INTERNAL_ERROR, retries=1); assert lc2.is_retry_eligible(max_retries=1) is False"
graders.name: retry-eligible-predicate

graders.run: uv run pytest tests/test_lifecycle.py tests/test_lifecycle_module_purity.py tests/test_harness.py -v
graders.name: lifecycle-and-harness-tests
